name: 70 Ophiuchi A
description: A nearby orange dwarf, 83% of the Sun's width: its disc was measured by interferometry.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 702A: radius in solar radii, 0.831 +/- 0.0044, from this work (CHARA)

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 702A: mass 0.846 solar masses from the K-band mass-luminosity relation of Henry & McCarthy (1993), not a dynamical mass

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 702A: effective temperature in K, 5407 +/- 52, from this work (CHARA)

text.card: A nearby orange dwarf whose disc was measured by interferometry: 83% of the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Interferometry gives it 0.831 solar radii; with its total light, that makes its surface 5,407 K.
